Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Job description:
 Join Jungheinrich in a working environment where you can make a big difference! With your knowledge and drive, as a team player you will make an important contribution to ensure that we as a company continue to be among the global leaders in our industry. Working side by side with colleagues who enjoy bold ideas and in a family environment that offers you every opportunity to reconcile your professional and private goals.
 Responsibilities: 
 • Develop and enhance SAP TM and GTT related applications, services, and extensions in SAP S/4HANA using Clean Core development principles. 
 • Design and implement upgrade-stable SAP solutions using modern development approaches, including ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS Views, OData services, SAP Fiori Elements, and SAPUI5 technologies. 
 • Implement API-driven and event-driven integration scenarios for Logistics Service Providers (LSPs), carriers, logistics networks, and external partners. 
 • Develop and optimize logistics integration solutions across SAP TM, SAP GTT, SAP SD, SAP LE, SAP MM, and adjacent supply chain processes. 
 • Design and develop interfaces and connectivity solutions between SAP and non-SAP systems using APIs, integration services, and cloud-based integration patterns. 
 • Build reusable APIs, Clean Core compliant extensions, semantic data models, and released object-based developments aligned with SAP best practices. 
 • Contribute to transportation execution, logistics visibility, event reporting, freight collaboration, and tracking scenarios. 
 • Support solution architecture decisions related to enterprise integration, scalability, system connectivity, and technical design. 
 • Collaborate closely with business analysts, requirements engineers, architects, product owners, functional consultants, and agile delivery teams to implement logistics and transportation requirements. 
 • Perform troubleshooting, root cause analysis, optimization, and technical support for logistics applications and integration scenarios. 
 • Support code reviews, technical documentation, testing activities, deployment processes, and development governance practices. 
 • Participate in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to international SAP transformation, rollout, modernization, and logistics integration projects. 
 Professional Competence: 
 • Professional experience as an SAP ABAP Developer with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA development and Clean Core engineering principles. 
 • Strong knowledge of ABAP Cloud, ABAP Development Tools (ADT), Clean ABAP, and maintainable software architecture concepts. 
 • Hands-on experience with RAP (RESTful Application Programming Model), CDS Views, OData services, SAP Fiori Elements, and SAPUI5 development. 
 • Experience with SAP Transportation Management (TM) processes, data models, and related logistics execution scenarios. 
 • Knowledge of SAP TM Customizing, BOPF, PPF (Post Processing Framework), and Web Dynpro development concepts. 
 • Experience with SAP Global Track and Trace (GTT) and logistics visibility solutions, including event-to-action integration concepts. 
 • Practical experience with API-based system integration, carrier connectivity, LSP integrations, and enterprise integration patterns. 
 • Strong understanding of logistics integration scenarios across SAP SD, LE, MM, and transportation execution processes. 
 • Experience developing custom ABAP solutions supporting transportation, tracking, visibility, and logistics collaboration processes. 
 Jungheinrich was founded in 1953 in Hamburg by Dr. Friedrich Jungheinrich as a family business. Today, we are one of the world's leading intralogistics companies with a unique product portfolio: from conventional industrial trucks to fully automated solutions intralogistics companies. Headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, Jungheinrich is represented by its own direct sales companies in 41 countries and by partner companies in around 80 other countries around the world, and employs more than 19,000 people internationally.
 We look forward to receiving your online application.
